'''Liar's Cut''' was a card game.<ref name="HSR" /> It was played in [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] such as the [[Aspre Plunge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira]],<ref name="SR">{{JournalCite|1|The Spira Regatta}}</ref> and the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref>
